blocks.text: Transition elements are notable for their ability to exist in multiple oxidation states. The feasibility of a redox reaction is determined by comparing the standard electrode potentials (E°) of the half-reactions involved. A reaction is feasible if the overall cell potential (E°cell) is positive.
In practice, the species with the more positive E° value will be reduced (gain electrons). The species with the more negative (less positive) value will be oxidized (lose electrons).
